tickets.title: Review and coordinate cash distribution request
tickets.text: Confirm the requested distribution amount, source account, destination, timing preference, tax withholding instructions, liquidity source, and any investment or retirement income impact before processing. Document client authorization and retain confirmation after the distribution is completed. The client Rowan Cloudpuddle wants to transfer $50,000 to Teacup Comet Bank and increase the monthly IRA distribution to $5,500, requiring confirmation of the source IRA account, the newer checking account ending in 7729, appropriate withholding, and liquidity source.

tickets.title: Coordinate account access recovery
tickets.text: Use this coordination template when a client cannot access an account portal, custodian login, document vault, or authentication method. Confirm identity requirements, preserve security, and document all handoffs without collecting passwords. The client Rowan Cloudpuddle cannot access the Velvet Acorn Custody portal after changing mobile carriers and needs access to retrieve recent confirmations and statements for distribution authorization.

subTasks.title: Confirm access problem and security boundaries
subTasks.text: Ask the client which portal is affected, what error message appears, whether multi-factor authentication changed, and what contact information is on file. Do not request or record passwords, full security answers, or authentication codes.

subTasks.title: Handoff to custodian or platform recovery channel
subTasks.text: Provide the client with the correct custodian or platform recovery path, required identification steps, and support contact method. If advisor involvement is permitted, confirm what authorization is needed before joining a call or submitting a service request.

subTasks.title: Verify restoration and update records
subTasks.text: After the client reports access is restored, confirm whether contact information, trusted contact, delivery preferences, or document access settings changed. Update internal notes and flag any suspicious activity for further review.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is portal access recovery, with a date of 2026-02-13.

tickets.title: Send care cost planning outreach
tickets.text:
Outreach purpose: Coordinate information needed to estimate care costs and funding options.

Hello [CONTACT_NAME],

I’m reaching out on behalf of Rowan Cloudpuddle to help organize the information needed for care cost planning. We are looking to understand the expected level of care, timing, available benefits, and likely monthly costs so the financial plan can reflect realistic assumptions.

Could you please provide or help identify the following?
- Current or anticipated care setting: [HOME_CARE/ASSISTED_LIVING/SKILLED_NURSING/OTHER]
- Estimated monthly care cost or rate sheet: [COST_DETAILS]
- Expected start timing or decision window: [TIMING]
- Insurance, long-term care policy, veterans benefits, Medicaid, or other benefits involved: [BENEFIT_DETAILS]
- Key decision-makers or required authorizations: [CONTACTS]
- Documents needed from Apricot Compass Advisory or the client: [DOCUMENTS]

Please let us know the best way to coordinate next steps and whether any privacy authorization is required before you can discuss details.

Thank you,
[ADVISOR_NAME]

Rowan needs the facility rate sheet, deposit information, and Silver Marmot Insurance claim requirements to estimate ongoing cash draw for Elena’s care.
tickets.evidence: That evidence remains needed, with a date of 2026-02-27.
